title: Capabilities
help: What this agent can do. For what it can't, Floorbit falls back to what older agents do; updating the agent turns it on.

name.syslog_hold: Keeps other agents' syslog for a takeover

yes.lease: Polls and logs in only while Floorbit says it is the primary.
yes.split: Polls, logs in to and handles only its own devices.
yes.syslog_hold: Sends only its own devices' lines and keeps a minute of the rest.
yes.self_update: Installs the signed agent releases Floorbit offers, with no new image.
yes.syslog_ids: Each line has an id, so a group's copies are kept once.
yes.plugin_updates: Installs signed plugin updates from the Marketplace, with no new image.
yes.key_roll: Fetches a new key itself when you roll it.
yes.cert: Makes its own key and has Floorbit sign its certificate.
yes.syslog: Relays the devices' syslog to Floorbit.
yes.netflow: Sums up flows in the hall; only totals leave the event network.
yes.snmp: Polls the devices over SNMP with Telegraf.
yes.gnmi: Subscribes to the devices' gNMI streams.
yes.mdt: Takes the telemetry streams devices send to it.
yes.mac_lookup: Finds a checked-in PC's port with a few SNMP GETs, where the range allows lookups.

no.lease: Falls back to VRRP: the agent holding the first shared address is primary.
no.split: Falls back to one primary collecting every device of the group.
no.syslog_hold: Falls back to sending every line; Floorbit keeps each line once.
no.self_update: Falls back to the pull command: the crew pulls the new image by hand.
no.syslog_ids: Its lines have no ids: in a group the same line can show twice.
no.plugin_updates: Plugins update only with a new agent image.
no.key_roll: Can't fetch a new key: a roll waits until the agent is updated.
no.cert: Serves only the certificate the crew gives it.
no.syslog: Syslog is off or not running on this agent.
no.netflow: Flows are off or not running on this agent.
no.snmp: No Telegraf on this agent, or telemetry is off: no SNMP polling.
no.traps: No Telegraf on this agent, or telemetry is off: no traps.
no.gnmi: No Telegraf on this agent, or telemetry is off: no gNMI.
no.mdt: No Telegraf on this agent, or telemetry is off: no MDT.
no.rest: Telemetry is off or not running on this agent.
no.mac_lookup: Check-in uses the polled ARP and MAC tables only.
